career_profile.title: Career Profile
career_profile.summary:
**Passionate Full-Stack Developer** with 5+ years of experience building *scalable web applications* and leading development teams. Expertise in **React**, **Node.js**, and **cloud technologies** with a strong focus on *code quality*, *performance optimization*, and *user experience*.

Proven track record of delivering **high-impact projects** from concept to production, including applications serving *100,000+ users*. Strong advocate for **clean code practices**, *test-driven development*, and *continuous integration*. Active open-source contributor with projects garnering **1,000+ GitHub stars**.

Seeking opportunities to leverage technical expertise and leadership skills to drive *innovation* and *technical excellence* in a **collaborative, growth-oriented environment**.

experiences.details:
**Led development** of microservices architecture serving 100,000+ daily active users
**Implemented** CI/CD pipeline reducing deployment time by 75% and eliminating production bugs
**Mentored** team of 4 junior developers, conducting code reviews and technical training sessions
**Built** real-time analytics dashboard using React, Node.js, and WebSocket connections
**Optimized** database queries and API performance, achieving 40% faster response times
**Collaborated** closely with Product and Design teams in Agile/Scrum environment

**Developed** responsive e-commerce platform handling $2M+ annual transactions
**Integrated** payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal) and third-party APIs (shipping, inventory)
**Implemented** automated testing suite achieving 90%+ code coverage
**Built** RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints for mobile and web applications
**Participated** in daily standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives
